chat.description: ADDITIVE permission set for the chat widget window (registry kind 'chat' — widget-system.md Phase 4). Two label shapes: the singleton `panel-chat`, and the parallel-thread instances `panel-chat-<hash>` that panel_instance_label mints when the title-bar '+' opens a chat panel with params (main.rs / chat.html). BOTH must be listed so the per-window ACL grants machine access (local shell) to every chat panel, not just the first — the broad `panel-*` glob in panels.json deliberately does NOT carry shell. The panel-* glob in panels.json already grants the dock/snap surface; this capability adds what the conversation needs beyond a settings panel: attachments (file dialog), machine access (local shell), thread persistence, the voice surface (PTT + speech), launching other widgets (gear → settings launcher; artifact pop-outs).

connectors.description: ADDITIVE permission set for the Connectors settings panel (label panel-settings-connectors, registry kind 'settings.connectors'). The panel-* glob in panels.json already grants the dock/snap surface plus open-external-url for the OAuth browser hop; this capability adds the client-brokered OAuth loopback commands the connector consent flow needs (start the loopback listener, wait for the redirect code, cancel). Scoped to THIS panel so the other settings panels don't inherit the loopback surface.

default.description: Default permission set for the main window

panels.description: Permission set for SYSTEM widget windows (panel-* — settings panels and prebuilt rails; design/widget-system.md 'First-Class Widgets'). System tier: pages shipped in the app bundle, never agent/user-authored content (that's widget-* + the sandbox). Inherits the widget windows' dock/snap surface plus the Tauri commands each panel type needs (updates today; more arrive with the Phase 3 settings migration).

widgets.description: Permission set for artifact widget windows (the deck — PRD Part C / W2). Opaque, frameless, always-on-top panels that render ONE pinned artifact and magnetically dock to the chat. The `widget-*` glob means any other label gets NO IPC at all (fails closed — PRD §23 derisk). These windows deliberately get a NARROWER set than the main window: they may move/resize/drag/close themselves and read the anchor window's geometry for snapping, connect to the same WS server (load-connection), and close themselves — nothing else.
